reviews.quote: High-quality & stable case, improved battery life, good system performance, OLED with high 4K resolution, Thunderbolt 4 & Wi-Fi 7, stylus attaches to case magnetically. Cons: RAM can't be upgraded, PWM flickering, OLED only at 60 Hz and without color profiles, neither HDMI nor an SD card reader. ("The high-end convertible suffers due to weak 4K OLED" — NBC review of the Yoga 9 14 2-in-1 Gen 10 Lunar Lake.)

praises: 4.54 stars across 50 Best Buy reviews — buyers consistently call it the best-sounding convertible on the market thanks to the rotating B&W soundbar hinge
Panther Lake efficiency keeps it cool and near-silent in everyday work, with battery lasting a full day of meetings and browsing
Bright 120Hz HDR OLED touch with included active pen is superb for markup, sketching, and streaming in tablet mode
Cosmic Blue machined-aluminium chassis at 1.32 kg feels like jewellery — the premium matches the price
Copilot+ NPU handles on-device AI features (live captions, image effects) without fan spin-up
complaints: $3,599.99 for integrated graphics — buyers openly balk at paying flagship money with no dGPU option (multiple BBY reviews note gaming is limited to low settings)
Only two USB-C ports; USB-A/HDMI users need a dock from day one
OLED moire on small text persists on this generation for sensitive users
Soldered RAM/SSD and glued-in design make repairs a board-swap affair
Occasional coil whine and fan ramp during charging + heavy tabs; Lenovo Vantage bloat nags

design_philosophy: The Yoga 9i is Lenovo's convertible flagship: machined aluminium, 360° rotating soundbar hinge with Bowers & Wilkins drivers that follow the mode you're in, OLED touch, and a pen that lives in the chassis. The Gen 11 Aura Edition moves to Panther Lake for Copilot+ AI and better battery, and this single Canadian retail tier (32GB/1TB, Cosmic Blue at Best Buy) is the line's flagship configuration — everything about it prioritises premium feel and media over raw performance.
rating_notes: Pro score attached from NBC review of the Yoga 9 14 2-in-1 G10 Aura Edition (89%, gap-fill 2026-11-24). Directly sold CA config with strong user base (BBY 4.54/50), but no pro review of the Gen 11 Panther Lake model found (NBC IMI9 review unlocatable; documented in SHARED-yoga9i.md). Ratings anchored on NBC 90.5% Gen 9 chassis review + BBY user aggregate, with Panther Lake deltas vs Lunar Lake sibling: gaming +0.5 (newer Arc), battery +0.3, thermals +0.5. Moire keeps screen_quality 8.8. avg_score 8.7 is the NBC-collection average for the chassis family (85.7% NBC aggregate / Mashable 94 / GadgetGuy 76), generation-adjacent disclosure.
